1	# Answer choices that leave a part of the question unlisted (line 2): census (D576, 2026-11-16, $0)
     2	
     3	**Answer: a pattern supports one hypothesis; it is not a proven cause.** Every failing send of the two readings read here (10 sends,
     4	7 topic instances) leaves out a clause that sits in the topic's `outcome` field and not in its `description`. In all seven, another
     5	attempt of the same topic lists that clause. The request never says that the outcome's clauses belong to "the topic's wording", and
     6	in the same sentence it names the outcome as the thing to judge. The hypothesis: the undefined term makes listing an outcome-only
     7	part a coin flip. The other attempts list the same clauses without any definition, and the earlier accounts were prompted with the
     8	disputed clause. So only sends can show whether a definition changes the rate.
     9	
    10	**Why it matters now:** since D570 the product's page shows each question's list of parts not judged beside its answer. An empty
    11	list on a topic that compares with last year tells a reader nothing was left out, when the comparison was.
    12	
    13	## The cases
    14	
    15	Scripts: `line2_census.py` (each send either first reader marks failing: the topic as the ladder step was given it, the send's own
    16	list, both readers' reasons, the topic's other sends' lists). Outputs: `fortnight.txt` (09-22 to 10-05, D563), `second-week.txt`
    17	(the week of 10-06, D550 and D551). The fresh week's six (09-22 to 09-28) are D547's record (`fresh-ladders/PROMPT-AUDIT-LINE-2.md`: "every
    18	failed attempt of the fresh week concerns a clause that sits only in the `outcome` field").
    19	
    20	| Reading | Topic | Sends failing (both first readers) | The unlisted part, in the outcome only | Other sends of the topic that list it |
    21	|---|---|---|---|---|
    22	| fortnight | clean-2, purchase commitments | p1 | "versus the prior year" | p2, p3 |
    23	| fortnight | clean-3, Blackwell to China | p2 | "so that China data-center revenue can resume" | p1, p3 |
    24	| fortnight | clean-6, Hugging Face deal | p3 | the price "being repriced" | p1, p2 |
    25	| fortnight | clean-7, MIIT approval | p2, p3 | "capping quantities" | p1 |
    26	| fortnight | clean-13, CPO shipments | p1, p2 | the Q4 2026 (15,000) and early-2027 (16,000) checkpoints | p3 |
    27	| second week | clean-1, Ohio lease guarantee | p2, p3 | "any amounts paid or accrued", "the remaining term" | p1 |
    28	| second week | clean-3, memory prices | p2 | "the memory makers' reported average selling prices and memory gross margins" | p1, p3 |
    29	| fresh week | three topics | six sends as marked (2 to 4 under July's rulings, D547) | outcome-only clauses | D547: an outcome-only clause listed 11 of 18 times |
    30	
    31	In clean-7 and clean-13 the failing sends do list the description's own extra part (the description's "allowing those sales to
    32	proceed"; the 30,000-unit checkpoint), and leave out the outcome's.
    33	
    34	**Marked by one first reader only (not settled; read beside):** fortnight clean-5 p2 and p3 ("compared with the nearly $800 billion",
    35	outcome only; no send of the topic lists it), clean-9 p2 (the $1.3 trillion comparison, outcome only; p1 and p3 list it); second
    36	week clean-8 p1 (the description's "up to 25% of the loss", the only description-only part in this census; p3 lists it). So a
    37	description part can be missed too (and July's two failures are description parts: the table by kind below).
    38	
    39	## The request, as the model reads it
    40	
    41	The topic arrives as fields: `"description": …, "outcome": …, "period": …`. The request's sentences on the list (the ladder step's
    42	`candidate-system.txt`, `candidate-closing.txt`, `candidate-schema.json`):
    43	
    44	- System: "A topic's wording may ask about more than one thing. Judge the one the topic's outcome names as what is tracked. List
    45	  every other part of the topic's wording that the question leaves out, a second figure or event, a condition or a comparison, in
    46	  not_judged …"
    47	- Schema, `not_judged`: "Every other part of the topic's wording that the question leaves out (a second figure or event, a condition,
    48	  a comparison); empty only when the question leaves nothing of the wording out."
    49	- Closing check: "does it ask one thing, the one the topic's outcome names, and is every other part of the topic's wording listed in
    50	  not_judged?"
    51	
    52	"The topic's wording" is never tied to a field. The outcome is named as the source of the one thing judged. A reader of the request
    53	can take the wording to be the description, with the outcome only telling which part of it to judge. That is the reading D547's
    54	stored accounts gave ("mostly reads the wording as the description alone"). Verdict (prompt audit): **missing**, the term undefined;
    55	the clauses missed are of the kind the request names (a comparison, a condition, a second figure).
    56	
    57	## By kind, across all four stored readings (the readers' original marks kept)
    58	
    59	The readings disagree on two kinds; on one kind they agree. Rows count failing attempts. "Matters" counts distinct matters: the
    60	fortnight re-opened the fresh week's articles with another Step 1 run, so its cloud-spending, Blackwell and Chinese-permission topics
    61	are the fresh week's matters again.
    62	
    63	| Kind | July (91 ladders, calibrated by third readers) | Fresh week (D547) | Week of 10-06 | Fortnight | Where it sits | Standing |
    64	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
    65	| **A second figure or event, or a difference inside an outcome, left unlisted** | 2 to 3 (the DeepSeek inquiry's penalties; graphics memory beside DRAM) | 2 (capping quantities) | 3 (amounts paid and the remaining term; makers' prices and margins) + 1 disputed (the 25% loss cap) | 5 (repricing; capping quantities ×2; two earlier checkpoints ×2) | July: the description; since: the outcome (one disputed in the description) | failed under every reading: **12 attempts on 7 matters**, plus 1 disputed |
    66	| A comparison with the reference figure or the prior year | 9 attempts left it unlisted; 7 passed by both first readers, 2 ruled passed by both third readers | 2 ($800 billion) | 0 | 1 (versus the prior year) + 3 disputed ($800 billion ×2, $1.3 trillion) | the outcome | July passes it; later readings fail it |
    67	| A consequence ("so that … can resume") | 2, passed by both first readers | 2 (Blackwell revenue) | 0 | 1 (the same matter) | the outcome | July passes it; later readings fail it |
    68	
    69	The kind every reading fails is also the kind the request names ("a second figure or event, a condition or a comparison"). Ten of its
    70	twelve attempts are outcome-only clauses. The two July cases sit in the description, so the defect is not only about the field. On
    71	the two disputed kinds the readers' threshold differs; a prompt change aimed at them would be tuning to one reading's rule.
    72	
    73	**Harm side, not yet counted:** attempts that list something that is not a part (how the answer is settled, or a distinction the
    74	answer choices already judge). No reader marks that, so this census cannot count it. One example from the fortnight: clean-6 pass 2
    75	lists "Whether the acquisition is repriced, delayed past the check date, or terminated as separate outcomes". Delay and termination
    76	are judged by its Still open and Ruled out choices; only the repricing is a part.
    77	
    78	## Prior decisions on this class
    79	
    80	- **D547** refused ruling that the wording is the description alone. D397 judges the main part and shows the rest as not judged.
    81	  D436 keeps a second side of the same bet, found in the outcome, "as context in that question … shown as not judged". So the
    82	  direction the record supports is the other one: the wording is both fields.
    83	- **D558** deferred a repair "for the day the list has a reader" (now, D570). It also warned that a single defining clause may not
    84	  be enough. D558 recorded misses on both fields in the week of 10-06; this census finds only the one disputed description case
    85	  there.
    86	- **D426** forbids tuning the step further on Alex's 44 topics; none of the cases above is one of them.
    87	
    88	## What it does not show
    89	
    90	- That a definition would make the model list these parts. The other sends of the same topics list them without one, so the miss
    91	  is a coin flip per send; only sends can show the change.
    92	- That listing every outcome clause is harmless. An outcome also names how the answer is settled ("as reflected in … disclosures")
    93	  and the event's own alternatives ("versus being … delayed past the check date or terminated"), which the answer choices already
    94	  judge. Neither is a part to list; no reader in this census asked for either.
   103	## 7. The recount against D397, D436 and the rulings of the July reading (`july_line2_recount.py`, `july-line2-sheet.json`), $0
   104	
   105	The July full run's reading (40 fresh theses, three attempts each, 91 ladders read by two families, differing marks ruled by a
   106	third reader of each family) is the calibrated one. What it did with each kind of left-out clause:
   107	
   108	| Kind | July: attempts that left it unlisted, and the marks | The fresh week's failed attempts of that kind |
   109	|---|---|---|
   110	| a comparison with the reference figure, in the outcome ("versus the roughly $650 billion they are reported to plan"; "versus the $119 billion cited in this item") | 9 attempts on 4 theses: 7 passed by both first readers; in the other 2 the Codex first reader failed it and **both third readers ruled it a pass** | the cloud companies' spending, attempts 1 and 2 ("compared with the nearly $800 billion"; the figure is carried as the reference): **a pass under the July rulings**; both fresh-week readers were stricter |
   111	| a consequence or a remark on why it matters, in the outcome ("which would raise write-down or utilisation risk"; "as a demand pool for Nvidia's AI accelerators") | 2 attempts, both passed by both first readers; no third-reader ruling | Blackwell to China, attempts 1 and 3 ("so that China data-center revenue can resume"): **disputed**. Under D436 the company's revenue could be a second side of the bet; the July first readers passed the like |
   112	| a difference inside an outcome, named in the outcome ("(behavioral remedies, commitments or fines)"; the scale of permitted purchases) | never left unlisted in July | the Chinese permission, attempts 1 and 3 ("capping quantities"): **stands**, by the request's own sentence |
   113	| a second figure or event named in the topic's question | the July failures of this line: the DeepSeek investigation (a conclusion and penalties asked, a finding accepted, nothing listed: ruled a failure) and graphics-memory prices beside commodity DRAM (failed by both first readers on one attempt, split on another) | none |
   114	
   115	So, with the original marks kept as they are: of the fresh week's six failures of line 2, two are a case the July third readers
   116	passed, two are disputed, two stand, on one question. July's own failures of the line are a different thing (a second figure
   117	or event of the question left out), 2 or 3 of 91 ladders.
   118	
   119	Sensitivity only (the historical verdicts do not change): the fresh week's line 2 fails on 6 attempts as marked, on 2 to 4 under
   120	the July rulings; its questions right in two of three attempts are 4 of 7 as marked, 5 or 6 of 7 under the July rulings.
   121	
   122	**No omission recurs on two distinct questions under an agreed reading; no prompt change is designed.**

     1	# The distance to the first gate, topic by topic, over the four stored readings (D556, under D439), 2026-11-15, $0
     2	
     3	What this is: every stored reading of the step that writes answer choices, restated per topic with the collector's own rules
     4	and reconciled to its report (`first_gate_map.py`; `proofs/first-gate-map.json`). A mark two readers agree on stands; where they
     5	differ it takes the two third readers' ruling when they rule alike, and is "open" otherwise. Classes come from the marks, the
     6	rulings and the reason the step gave for declining; nothing is judged anew. What it cannot do: prove the gate out of reach on
     7	future topics, show that any change would work, or trigger D544's reversal. The four readings are four populations read in
     8	different ways and stay apart; the 104 topics include repeated runs of the same news.

    53	## 4. What the record supports as a direction, and what it does not
    54	
    55	- **The count by written choices has one class on the record that is this step's alone and large in one reading:** an event's
    56	  reference left empty. Without it, and with nothing else changed, July's 22 would be at most 27 of 40 against 26: a paper
    57	  upper bound, not a predicted result. It is two matters in one population, one attempt this week and two in Alex's topics;
    58	  and the field it concerns is one the judge is never shown for an event, so removing the fault would move the count and
    59	  nothing a reader of the product sees. It has never been put to a prompt audit. Reference marks on figures are a separate
    60	  matter (a baseline amount, not an expectation in words) and are kept apart.
    61	- **Unlisted parts** are the whole shortfall of the fresh week (three topics) and part of this week's; the audit of D547
    62	  stands as it was left.
    63	- **The refusals by rule** (no main part, a period that is not a year, no listed theme) account for 8 or 9 of the 13 short
    64	  topics among Alex's 44, 10 of July's 18 and 2 or 3 of this week's 6. Every one has a decision behind it or a stopped line, and a
    65	  good part of them are topics that should not be answered at all: the survey (D417), the two stakes, the background sentence.
    66	  An answerable but unworthy question is not a recovery.
    67	- **The zero-fault lines have no bounded direction on this record.** Each reading carries 6 to 8 agreed faults on them (on 5% to
    68	  29% of its attempts), of different kinds each time, on a step that was tuned through three readings and then frozen. Nothing
    69	  stored shows a set of changes that would bring all four to zero at once. This is the part of the gate that the record does
    70	  not show within reach.
    71	- **The form itself leaves many marks unsettled:** 12 to 39 open points a reading; the due day is the largest kind in three of
    72	  the four (in July it is whether a refusal was justified). Until that is settled, every reading has two answers, and the one
    73	  with the open points against has never passed.

    76

    78	  the day: 60 days after the company's fiscal year-end, 90 days after the calendar year-end for a theme's figure. The reading
    79	  form says that day is right when the figure is that year's.

    81	  figures are published in the annual report around 2027-02; use that day as the due date."
    82	- **Where the readers part on it:** this week 10 open points (topics 1, 2, 8 and 13, due 2027-04-01); the fresh week, the two
    83	  commitment questions (one family fails "April 1" against "around February"); July, the class the result page lists as
    84	  "an obligation already taken on is due at the expected annual-report month or at code's day", eight of which D470 read
    85	  provisionally by D414.
    86	- **What D414 does not settle:** an event's day taken as the end of a month the topic gives approximately (this week 11 open
    87	  points), the closing window of a signed deal against "its next annual filing", and whether a price on the last day of a
    88	  year is a year's figure (2 open points).
    89	- Nothing is re-marked here. A later reading scored across this conflict would again have two answers.

item.text:
**The revised census supports designing a candidate, but the proposed scope still needs clarification before it is used.** The main issue is the claim that comparisons and consequences will remain unchanged: defining “wording” to include `outcome` can change how the model treats them, even if the candidate is motivated by other cases.

- **Keep the existing comparison instruction.** The current request lists “a second figure or event, a condition **or a comparison**.” The proposed summary omits “comparison” while saying those cases stay as they are. Preserve the existing wording, and test comparisons and consequences as potential regressions; do not assume the field definition leaves their behavior unchanged. [Current request]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/ladder/candidate-system.txt:5), [census]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/CENSUS.md:63).

- **State the exclusions as questions for the design, not settled universal rules.** An answer choice may judge a distinction even when the question does not spell it out; a settlement source may also be part of what a particular topic asks. Map both to D397, D436 and the actual choices, with counterexamples, before writing a general sentence. The cap on an approval remains a required positive case. [D436]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4847), [prior recount]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/fresh-ladders/PROMPT-AUDIT-LINE-2.md:108).

- **Narrow the census’s agreement claim.** The grouped class includes different kinds of omission; it does not show that every reading judged every kind the same way. The table also says July has **2 to 3** failures and the later week has one disputed case, but its total says “12 … plus 1 disputed.” Account for the July disputed attempt separately or explain its disposition. The pattern is useful without treating the combined class as a single agreed judgement. [Census table]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/CENSUS.md:57), [July recount]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/fresh-ladders/PROMPT-AUDIT-LINE-2.md:112).

The same-day unchanged control and blind harm reading are the right direction. The design should specify the paired inputs, unresolved marks, stopping rule, cost and separate fresh acceptance before any send. Read the whole output for regressions, not only the two named kinds of false listing; a model can change the question or choices too.

CONSENSUS: no, because the proposed field definition can affect the disputed comparisons and consequences, and the census’s combined agreement and disputed count need correction.
